target: Arquitectura exterior del asentamiento secundario Parada de los Cardos, transición Korven/Edran.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: ARCHITECTURE / SETTLEMENT — NO CREATURE. Caserío de ruta pequeño para descanso, intercambio de cargas y noticias. Debe mostrar transición entre piedra compacta y llanura abierta sin competir con Brumak o Valdren.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: ARCHITECTURE / SETTLEMENT — NO CREATURE. Create a wide exterior scene of Parada de los Cardos, a tiny route hamlet where Korven gives way to Edran. Use only a handful of low practical structures around a widened road shoulder, with sheltered space for resting and transferring loads. Construction combines available stone bases with simple timber as the landscape becomes softer and more open. Hardy cardos and low plain vegetation mark the surroundings. It should feel like a useful pause on a long road, not a destination town.
negative_constraints: No market town, fortress, temple or large inn
No monumental gates, walls or towers
No ornate cultural symbols or readable signs
No characters or creatures as focal subject
notes: Asentamiento secundario canónico; no presupone tienda, NPC fijo ni economía.
